comment: Dr. Sevin's lectures were always relevant. Her teaching style made the concepts pretty easy to understand and I felt prepared for the 3 quizzes & final. Multiple office hours during the week. Sometimes went on tangents but didn't detract from the class

She's takes a long time to grade and can be unclear about requirements, but an easy bio 199 with lots of field trips and outdoor labs. she's nice and the class is mostly pretty interesting, but be prepared to wait weeks to get feedback on assignments and quizzes. homework is light though and only a few quizzes.

Dr. Sevin is an overall fantastic professor. She is very flexible and understands that you have other priorities in life other than class. Dr. Sevin never gade me a hard time for having to miss class for excused absences of other extracurriculars. Her slides are easy to follow and tests are reasonable, not easy, but not impossible.

Dr. Sevin absolutely made my fall semester freshman year! I actually looked forward to every lab we had to do and can only remember a few assignments that actually were long. Such a good choice for BIO 199.

Dr. Sevin is the best. She is knowledgeable and has lots of relevant work experience. She is flexible, funny, and wants you to succeed. Biology 202 is pretty straight-forward, but can get the best of you if you slack off too much. She recognizes the students that engage in class, to which you get to build an authentic relationship with her.

Dr. Sevin is a down-to-earth, authentic person, and my favorite teacher so far. I would recommend her to anyone. Her lectures are thorough and easy to follow. So as long as you pay attention, you don't need to stress about the readings. She is approachable and thoroughly knowledgeable about ecology, environmental science, and biology.

Her class was very fun and engaging. She is very good at explaining material and getting her point across. I really enjoyed having her class my first semester at UR and I would for sure take it again. Recommend to anyone

Jen is one of the best professors I've had! If you are looking for an easy class for the science gen ed Ecology is your class. The lectures are easy to follow and her expectations are very clear from day one. Jen is extremely passionate about her work and is always there to help if you are struggling with something. TAKE THIS CLASS

I would recommend this course to anybody trying to fulfill their Gen Ed or wants to go into conservation. She would often go out of her way to make sure her student's needs were met. A large portion of the class was outside, and focused on group projects, so if you want to be in the field TAKE THIS CLASS

Dr. Jen is a great professor. Her lectures and activities are very hands-on and informative and it makes you really enjoy Ecology. It's also not a difficult class, so it is one that you can actually enjoy instead of just stressing about it. I highly recommend taking a class with Dr. Jen.

Dr. Sevin is an awesome teacher. She is extremely knowledgable about what she is talking about and has many cool experiences if you ask her about it. Intro to Ecology was very easy, but I would guess that her other upper-level classes were harder. She is a fun teacher who wants everyone to learn! Would definitely recommend.

Dr. Jen is easily one of my favorite professors at UR. She is super approachable and cares a lot about her students. She really prioritized getting us out in the field, and she really made class enjoyable. As long as you are thorough and understand her grading expectations, which admittedly I occasionally struggled to do, you should be just fine.
